page.layout: One printed page, blank, with a handwritten note "A.xxix." and a pencilled number "29" in the upper left; a fragment of the neighbouring page at the right edge.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from manuscript marks, which are not printed text and are not transcribed: the pencilled "29" at upper left and the ink "A.xxix." near the top centre. At the right edge, a fragment of the facing page shows partial letters ("AN", "CO", "Appu...") which belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. The sheet is torn and stained at the left and bottom edges.
